summary: The agent built a complex Excel compensation model using openpyxl, demonstrating advanced techniques for formula-first design, named ranges, multi-year projections, and tiered calculations. Although the final file was created, the task failed verification (test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite failed). This skill captures the reusable workflow for building sophisticated financial models in Excel with Python, including the critical pattern of using wb.define_name() for named ranges (not wb.defined_names dict API), validation strategies, and the anti-pattern of requiring formula strings without '=' prefix in openpyxl.
